elements.element: Customer is not subject to any employee non-solicitation restriction.
elements.evidence: The clause expressly prohibits the Customer/Licensee, as one of “neither party,” from soliciting certain employees of the other party.

elements.element: The non-solicitation restriction applies mutually to both parties.
elements.evidence: The clause states that “neither party” may solicit covered employees of “the other party.”

elements.element: The restriction is limited to personnel directly involved in the services.
elements.evidence: It applies only to an employee of the other party “who was directly involved in the performance of this Agreement.”

elements.element: The restriction lasts no more than 12 months from the end of the relevant individual’s involvement in the services.
elements.evidence: Although the clause includes 12 months after the individual’s last involvement, it also independently applies “During the Term.” If an individual’s involvement ends more than 12 months before the Term ends, the restriction continues beyond the permitted 12 months.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from solicitation.
elements.evidence: The definition expressly excludes “generally advertising job openings” and follow-up with individuals responding to those advertisements.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches by personnel are excluded from solicitation.
elements.evidence: The definition excludes activities following inquiries voluntarily initiated by the individual.

elements.element: The clause does not prohibit hiring covered personnel.
elements.evidence: The operative restriction prohibits solicitation to leave employment, but contains no separate prohibition on hiring or employing an individual.

result.reason: The redline achieves mutuality, limits the covered population, preserves both required carve-outs, and does not impose a no-hire. However, the separate “During the Term” restriction can extend beyond 12 months after an individual’s involvement ends, so the fallback duration is not satisfied. The clause would need to apply solely during the 12-month period following the end of each relevant individual’s involvement.
